U13

U13 cup win. 95 to 53.

1 October 2026 · Talata Basketball
95 · 53
Talata U13 · Køge Bugt · U13 Cup East · Svanemøllehallen

Our U13s hosted Køge Bugt in the cup on Thursday evening and won 95 to 53 at Svanemøllehallen.

Five days after the league win at SISU, the same group backed it up at home. A team win, and well done to every player on the team sheet.

Thank you to Køge Bugt for making the trip.

What comes next

The next U13 games, dates and halls are on the games page.
